(__uiZhValue=>d.locale==="zh-CN"?(new Map([["Two-tier memory system that makes Claude a true workplace collaborator. Decodes shorthand, acronyms, nicknames, and internal language so Claude understands requests like a colleague would. CLAUDE.md for working memory, memory/ directory for the full knowledge base.","通过两层记忆系统，让 Claude 更好地理解你的工作。识别简写、缩写、昵称和内部用语，像同事一样理解你的需求。CLAUDE.md 保存日常工作记忆，memory/ 目录保存完整知识库。"],["Initialize the productivity system and open the dashboard. Use when setting up the plugin for the first time, bootstrapping working memory from your existing task list, or decoding the shorthand (nicknames, acronyms, project codenames) you use in your todos.","初始化任务与记忆系统，并打开仪表板。适合首次设置插件、根据现有任务列表建立工作记忆，或解释待办事项中的简写、昵称、缩写和项目代号。"],["Simple task management using a shared TASKS.md file. Reference this when the user asks about their tasks, wants to add/complete tasks, or needs help tracking commitments.","通过共享的 TASKS.md 文件管理任务。可用于查看、添加或完成任务，以及跟进承诺事项。"],["Sync tasks and refresh memory from your current activity. Use when pulling new assignments from your project tracker into TASKS.md, triaging stale or overdue tasks, filling memory gaps for unknown people or projects, or running a comprehensive scan to catch todos buried in chat and email.","根据近期活动同步任务并更新记忆。可将项目管理工具中的新任务汇入 TASKS.md、整理久未更新或逾期的任务、补充人员和项目背景，或全面查找聊天与邮件中遗漏的待办事项。"],["Reflective pass over your memory files — merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index.","检查并整理记忆文件：合并重复内容、修正过时信息，并精简索引。"],["Show what's using your context window","查看哪些内容占用了上下文窗口。"],["Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation.","用于创建、读取、编辑和处理 Word 文档（.docx）或模板（.dotx）。提到 Microsoft Word 文档、Word doc、word document、.docx、.dotx 或 microsoft doc 时可使用。也适合提取或重组文档内容、插入或替换图片、查找替换、处理修订和批注，以及整理成完整的 Word 文档。如果需要交付可下载、发送邮件或打印的 Word 或 .docx 文件，使用此技能。如果只要求文档、页面、报告、备忘录或笔记，未指定格式，而当前会话提供了 Claude 专用的文档或页面技能、连接器，则优先使用那些工具，即使最终需要邮件发送或打印。此技能不用于 PDF、电子表格、Google Docs 或与文档生成无关的编程。"],["Explain where this session's tokens went, with one simple chart in plain language. Use when the user says things like \"explain my usage\", \"where did my tokens go\", or asks for a usage breakdown.","用一张简单图表和易懂的语言，说明本次会话的 token 用量分布。适合回答 explain my usage、where did my tokens go 等用量查询，或提供用量明细。"],["Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.","为新界面或现有界面改版提供视觉设计建议，帮助确定风格、字体和设计细节，让界面更有辨识度，避免套用普通模板。"],["Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.","用于处理 PDF 文件，包括读取或提取文字和表格、合并、拆分、旋转页面、添加水印、创建 PDF、填写表单、加密和解密、提取图片，以及对扫描件进行 OCR 识别，使其可以搜索。提到 .pdf 文件或需要生成 PDF 时可使用。"],["Use this skill when you need to read, inspect, or extract content from PDF files — especially when file content is NOT in your context and you need to read it from disk. Covers content inventory, text extraction, page rasterization for visual inspection, embedded image/attachment/table/form-field extraction, and choosing the right reading strategy for different document types (text-heavy, scanned, slide-decks, forms, data-heavy). Do NOT use this skill for PDF creation, form filling, merging, splitting, watermarking, or encryption — use the pdf skill instead.","用于读取、检查或提取 PDF 内容，尤其适合文件内容尚未载入上下文、需要从磁盘读取的情况。涵盖内容清点、文字提取、页面转为图片进行检查、嵌入图片及附件、表格和表单字段提取，并根据文本密集、扫描件、幻灯片、表单或数据密集等文档类型选择阅读方式。不用于创建 PDF、填写表单、合并、拆分、添加水印或加密；这些操作请使用 pdf 技能。"],["Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill.","用于涉及 .pptx 或 .potx 文件的任务，无论它是输入、输出还是两者兼有。支持创建 PowerPoint（.pptx）幻灯片和演示文稿；读取、解析或提取 .pptx、.potx 中的文字，即使提取后会用于邮件、摘要或其他演示文稿；编辑、更新、合并或拆分幻灯片文件，以及处理模板（.potx）、版式、演讲者备注和批注。用户要求 PowerPoint、.pptx 文件，或提到 .pptx、.potx 文件名时可使用。如果只要求幻灯片或演示文稿而未指定格式，当前会话有专用演示文稿功能或独立的幻灯片技能时优先使用它们，否则使用此技能。"],["Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically. Use when the user says things like \"every day\", \"each morning\", \"remind me in an hour\", \"run this at noon\", or wants to reschedule an existing task.","创建或更新自动运行的计划任务。适合每天、每天早晨、一小时后提醒、中午运行等安排，也可调整已有任务的时间。"],["Guided setup — install a matching plugin, try a skill, connect tools.","引导完成设置：安装合适的插件、试用技能并连接工具。"],["Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like \"the xlsx in my downloads\") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.","用于以电子表格文件作为主要输入或输出的任务，包括打开、读取、编辑或修复 .xlsx、.xlsm、.xltx、.csv、.tsv 文件，添加列、计算公式、调整格式、制图或清理数据；从零或其他数据源创建表格；以及转换表格格式。用户提到文件名或路径并要求处理该文件时可使用，也适合把错位表头、异常行和杂乱数据整理为规范表格。最终交付物必须是电子表格文件。如果主要交付物是 Word 文档、HTML 报告、独立 Python 脚本、数据库数据处理流程或 Google Sheets API 集成，即使涉及表格数据，也不使用此技能。"]]).get(__uiZhValue)??__uiZhValue):__uiZhValue)(e.description)

edits.original:
Set this only for an IdP that implements RFC 8707 resource indicators. The app then sends `resource=<value>` on the authorization, token and refresh requests, so the access token the IdP issues is audience-restricted to the gateway or proxy rather than to the IdP's own APIs. Use it with `bearerTokenType: access_token`; in `id_token` mode the ID token's audience is always `clientId`. Ignored with the OS-broker sign-in flow (the sign-in flow key set to `broker`), which is Entra-only.

**Microsoft Entra ID:** leave unset — the v2.0 endpoint rejects `resource`; request the API scope in `scopes` instead (`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`). **AD FS:** enter one of the relying-party trust's identifiers, spelled as it is registered there. A value with no scheme (a host name with or without a port or path, a single name, or a GUID; `name:digits` also reads as a host name with a port) is sent as `https://<value>`; an identifier with a scheme of its own (`urn:…`, or an organization-defined one such as `VENDOR:URI:…`) is sent exactly as written. A trust whose only identifier is a bare name or GUID will not match, because those are sent as `https://<value>`: add an `https://…` or `urn:…` identifier to the trust and enter that one here. With any other identity provider, use an absolute URI without a fragment (RFC 8707 — the IdP rejects one as `invalid_target`). Changing it signs users in again.
edits.translation:
仅实现 RFC 8707 资源指示器的 IdP 使用。应用在授权、令牌、刷新请求发送 `resource=<value>`，使访问令牌受众限定为网关或代理，而非 IdP 自身 API。配合 `bearerTokenType: access_token` 使用；`id_token` 模式的 ID 令牌受众始终为 `clientId`。仅 Entra 的系统身份代理流程（`broker`）忽略此项。

**Microsoft Entra ID：**留空，v2.0 拒绝 `resource`，改在 `scopes` 请求 API 作用域（`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`）。**AD FS：**填写依赖方信任已注册的一个标识，拼写须一致。无协议值（可带端口/路径的主机名、单名称、GUID；`name:digits` 也按主机加端口）作为 `https://<value>` 发送；自带协议的标识（`urn:…` 或组织自定义 `VENDOR:URI:…`）原样发送。信任若仅有纯名称/GUID，会因按 `https://<value>` 发送而不匹配，应添加 `https://…` 或 `urn:…` 标识并填写。其他 IdP 用无片段的绝对 URI（RFC 8707，否则报 `invalid_target`）。修改会使用户重新登录。

Use it with `bearerTokenType: access_token`; in `id_token` mode the ID token's audience is always `clientId`. edits.original: In **access-token** mode the token's audience must be your gateway or proxy. On IdPs where the requested scopes decide the audience (**Entra ID**), include its API resource scope in `scopes` — `api://<gateway-app-id>/.default`, or a named delegated scope you exposed via *Expose an API*. With only the standard OIDC scopes (`openid profile email offline_access`) Entra returns a v1.0 Microsoft Graph token whose issuer (`https://sts.windows.net/<tenant>/`) doesn't match the v2.0 issuer configured here, so a gateway that validates `iss` rejects it. On IdPs that set the access-token audience out-of-band (Keycloak audience mapper, Auth0 default audience, Okta custom authorization server), a resource scope in `scopes` isn't required — the audience comes from the IdP-side configuration.
edits.translation: **访问令牌**模式的受众须为网关或代理。请求作用域决定受众的 IdP（**Entra ID**）须在 `scopes` 包含 API 资源作用域：`api://<gateway-app-id>/.default` 或通过*公开 API*注册的命名委托作用域。仅标准 OIDC 作用域（`openid profile email offline_access`）时，Entra 返回 v1.0 Microsoft Graph 令牌，其签发方（`https://sts.windows.net/<tenant>/`）与此处 v2.0 不符，检查 `iss` 的网关会拒绝。IdP 通过其他配置决定受众（Keycloak audience mapper、Auth0 default audience、Okta custom authorization server）时，`scopes` 无需资源作用域，受众来自 IdP 设置。

edits.original:
For inference providers without native web search (Bedrock, custom gateways). On Anthropic API and Vertex, the model’s built-in web search is available without this.

The provider’s API key is a credential — have the **headers helper script** print its auth header rather than storing it in `headers`:
- **Brave** — `X-Subscription-Token`
- **Exa** — `x-api-key`
- **Tavily** — `Authorization` (Bearer …)

To turn web search off entirely, or to require approval for each search, list the bare `WebSearch` name in `disabledBuiltinTools` or `builtinToolPolicy`; it takes no per-host scope.
edits.translation:
用于无原生网页搜索的提供商（Bedrock、自定义网关）。Anthropic API/Vertex 的模型内置搜索无需此项。

提供商 API 密钥是凭据，应让**请求头助手脚本**输出认证头，不存于 `headers`：
- **Brave**：`X-Subscription-Token`
- **Exa**：`x-api-key`
- **Tavily**：`Authorization`（Bearer …）

完全关闭或逐次审批搜索时，在 `disabledBuiltinTools` 或 `builtinToolPolicy` 列出单独 `WebSearch`，不支持按主机限定范围。

edits.original: With Continuous Access Evaluation the server declares the `cp1` client capability, so Microsoft Entra issues access tokens that live up to about 28 hours and are cut off within minutes by a claims challenge when an administrator revokes sessions, disables the account, or the user’s risk changes — and, where the tenant enforces an IP named-location or Global Secure Access compliant-network Conditional Access policy, when the token is presented from outside that network. Tenants without such a policy get the longer lifetime and the fast revocation but no network-based replay protection; set `disabled` to keep standard one-hour, non-CAE tokens on every sign-in path. A change applies to tokens issued after the connector respawns with it; an already-cached long-lived token is served until it expires (Disconnect → Connect signs in afresh).
edits.translation: 持续访问评估下，服务器声明 `cp1` 客户端能力，Microsoft Entra 签发最长约 28 小时的访问令牌。管理员撤销会话、禁用账户或用户风险改变时，通过声明质询在几分钟内撤销；租户实施 IP 命名位置或 Global Secure Access 合规网络条件访问时，从网络外提交也会撤销。无此策略的租户有长有效期和快速撤销，但无按网络防重放。设为 `disabled` 可在所有登录路径保留标准一小时非 CAE 令牌。更改对连接器重新启动后新签发的令牌生效；已缓存长令牌继续使用到到期，“断开 → 连接”可重新登录。

edits.original:
Absolute path to an executable that prints a single JSON object of environment variables to stdout, e.g. `{"API_KEY": "…"}`. The app runs it before spawning the server and merges the result over `env` (the helper wins on conflict). Use this to pull secrets from a secrets manager instead of storing them inline in `env`.

- If the helper fails, the server does not start; the failure names the helper path in the app log and the diagnostics report.
- A helper with nothing to set must print `{}`. Empty stdout is treated as a failure.
- A helper-emitted `PATH` replaces the static map’s `PATH` and supports the same `${PATH}` placeholder expansion as a static entry.
edits.translation:
向 stdout 输出单个环境变量 JSON 的可执行文件绝对路径，如 `{"API_KEY": "…"}`。启动服务器前运行，结果覆盖 `env`，冲突以助手为准。用于从机密管理器取值，避免内联存于 `env`。

- 失败则不启动服务器，在日志和诊断中指出助手路径。
- 无需设置值时须输出 `{}`，空 stdout 视为失败。
- 助手 `PATH` 替换静态映射 `PATH`，支持相同 `${PATH}` 占位符展开。

edits.original:
- **`browser`** (default) — opens the system browser for an authorization-code (PKCE) sign-in on the loopback redirect URI.
- **`broker`** — signs in through the OS identity broker (Web Account Manager on Windows, the Company Portal SSO extension on macOS), so it can satisfy Conditional Access policies that require a compliant or managed device or token protection. Requires **Tenant ID**, **Client ID**, and **Scope**. The app registration must list the broker redirect URIs `ms-appx-web://Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin/{client-id}` (Windows) and `msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop://auth` (macOS) under the **Mobile and desktop applications** platform, and the device must be Entra-registered (macOS also needs the Company Portal SSO extension). Not supported on Linux. When the broker is not available on a device, sign-in falls back to the system browser.

App versions that predate this key always use the system browser.
edits.translation:
- **`browser`**（默认）：系统浏览器通过回环 URI 执行授权码 PKCE 登录。
- **`broker`**：系统身份代理（Windows WAM、macOS Company Portal SSO），满足合规/受管理设备或令牌保护的条件访问。必填**租户 ID**、**客户端 ID**、**作用域**。注册须在**移动和桌面应用程序**平台列出 `ms-appx-web://Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin/{client-id}`（Windows）、`msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop://auth`（macOS），设备须 Entra 注册，macOS 还需 Company Portal SSO。Linux 不支持。设备代理不可用时回退系统浏览器。

早于此键的版本始终系统浏览器登录。

edits.original: Claude runs the executable with no arguments whenever that server connects and whenever its sign-in is refreshed in the background (the result is not cached), and reads **stdout**, which must be exactly one JSON object of the form `{"clientSecret": "…"}`: no other keys, and no banner or log lines before or after it (write those to stderr, which is only logged; keep stdout and stderr together under 64 KB). The helper must exit with code `0` within 30 seconds. Any other output stops that server from connecting, with an error that names its `clientSecretHelper`, instead of sending a wrong value to the identity provider. Use this to pull the secret from Keychain, 1Password CLI, or an internal secret broker instead of writing it into the configuration, and prefer a helper that does not prompt the user, since it also runs during background refreshes.
edits.translation: 每次服务器连接及后台刷新登录时，Claude 无参数运行此文件（结果不缓存），读取 **stdout**，必须恰为 `{"clientSecret": "…"}` 格式的单个 JSON，不得有其他键或前后横幅/日志。日志写到 stderr，仅记录；stdout/stderr 合计不超过 64 KB。助手须在 30 秒内以 `0` 退出。其他输出会阻止服务器连接并在错误中指出其 `clientSecretHelper`，避免向 IdP 发送错误值。用于从 Keychain、1Password CLI 或内部代理取机密，而非写入配置；也在后台运行，因此优先使用不提示用户的助手。

edits.original: Also governs the same server when an installed plugin provides it. A plugin's MCP server matches an entry by URL, else by name (case-insensitive; a plugin server that runs locally matches by name only), and then follows that entry's `toolPolicy` alone: `orgPluginSettings` is not consulted for it, even when the entry sets no `toolPolicy`. A built-in entry (one with `server`) is the exception: it applies to a plugin's server of the same name only when a `toolPolicy` is written on it, and then carries that `toolPolicy` and the built-in's rule that its send and other irreversible tools cannot be loosened below `ask`, but not the built-in's other default prompts. An `http`, `sse` or `stdio` entry is also a server the app itself connects to or launches. To set permissions for a server that only a plugin runs, without the app connecting to or launching anything, use an entry with `transport: "policy-only"`.

edits.original:
An entry with `transport: "policy-only"` is not a server: it sets tool permissions for an MCP server that an installed plugin provides, and nothing else. Set `name` to the server's name as the plugin declares it (matched case-insensitively) and `toolPolicy` to the permissions. The plugin keeps launching or connecting to its own server; the app never connects to, launches or lists anything for the entry, so it takes no `url`, `command`, `oauth` or other connection settings (an entry that sets one is rejected). It takes precedence over `orgPluginSettings` for that server in chat, Cowork and Code sessions alike; with no `toolPolicy` the server is left unrestricted. An entry whose name matches no installed plugin server does nothing.

Desktop versions that predate `policy-only` do not recognise it: they drop the entry (listed under Configuration parse errors in the diagnostics report) and apply `orgPluginSettings` to that server instead. If every entry in the list is `policy-only`, those versions cannot read `managedMcpServers` at all: they report a parse error for it and, until they are updated, leave MCP servers that users added themselves, or that a project's `.mcp.json` declares, out of Code sessions. While older versions are still in use, keep the same permissions in `orgPluginSettings` too, and do not deploy a list made only of `policy-only` entries until every desktop has updated.
edits.translation:
`transport: "policy-only"` 条目不是服务器，只设置已安装插件提供的 MCP 工具权限。`name` 填插件声明的服务器名（不区分大小写），`toolPolicy` 填权限。插件仍自己启动或连接，应用不为此条目连接、启动或列出任何服务器，因此不接受 `url`、`command`、`oauth` 等连接设置，包含则拒绝。聊天/Cowork/Code 中均优先于该服务器的 `orgPluginSettings`；无 `toolPolicy` 则不限制。名称不匹配已安装插件服务器时无效果。

早于 `policy-only` 的版本不识别，会丢弃条目并在诊断解析错误中列出，改用 `orgPluginSettings`。若全部条目均为 `policy-only`，旧版本无法读取整个 `managedMcpServers`，报解析错误，在更新前不向 Code 提供用户添加或项目 `.mcp.json` 声明的 MCP。仍使用旧版本时，也在 `orgPluginSettings` 保留相同权限；全设备更新前不要部署只有 `policy-only` 条目的列表。

edits.old: "Browser AI faces unique security risks, like prompt injection attacks, where malicious actors might try to trick Claude into unintended actions, such as sharing your bank information or deleting important files. While we\u2019ve implemented protections, they aren\u2019t foolproof. Attack vectors are constantly evolving and Claude may hallucinate, leading to actions that you did not intend. We\u2019ve shared our testing results, including possible attack scenarios, so you can make informed decisions, and strongly encourage you to <risksLink>read about the risks</risksLink> before using this product. <blogLink>Read blog post</blogLink>"
edits.replacement: "浏览器 AI 面临着独特的安全风险，例如提示注入攻击，恶意行为者可能会试图诱骗 Claude 进行意外操作，例如共享你的银行信息或删除重要文件。虽然我们已经实施了保护措施，但它们并不是万无一失的。攻击向量不断演变，Claude 可能会产生幻觉，从而导致你不希望采取的行动。我们分享了我们的测试结果，包括可能的攻击场景，以便你可以做出明智的决定，并强烈建议你在使用此产品之前<risksLink>阅读风险</risksLink>。 <blogLink>阅读博客文章</blogLink>"

edits.original: Setting this key asks for 3P mode. The app opens in 3P mode unless the user chose to sign in to Claude.ai at the login screen, a choice `disableDeploymentModeChooser` removes. In 3P mode, if the selected provider's required credential keys are missing or invalid, the app shows a configuration error. A value the app cannot read (a misspelt, wrongly cased or unknown provider, or a value of the wrong type) still counts as set when machine-wide device management sent it: a macOS configuration profile, Windows policy under `HKLM`, or the root-owned policy file on Linux. The app then asks for 3P mode and, in 3P mode, shows a configuration error whose details name this key. An unreadable `bootstrapUrl` from the same sources counts the same way unless `bootstrapEnabled` is `false`. An unreadable value does not count where the user can write it: the local configuration file, or Windows policy under `HKCU`. Neither does an empty value (a value of only spaces is unreadable, not empty), or a Windows value of type `REG_BINARY`, `REG_MULTI_SZ` or `REG_QWORD`. Each of those reads as not set. When this key is not set, the app launches in standard mode unless another setting asks for 3P mode, such as a `bootstrapUrl` that `bootstrapEnabled` has not turned off. Keys for providers other than the selected one are ignored. Each provider's required keys are documented on its dedicated page under Inference providers.
edits.translation: 设置此键请求第三方模式。除非用户在登录页选择 Claude.ai（`disableDeploymentModeChooser` 可移除此选择），应用使用第三方模式。所选提供商必需凭据键缺失或无效时显示配置错误。机器范围管理下发的不可读值（拼写/大小写错误、未知提供商或类型错误）仍算已设置：macOS 配置、Windows `HKLM` 策略、Linux root 所有文件；应用仍请求第三方模式，并在详情指出此键。同来源不可读的 `bootstrapUrl` 也如此，除非 `bootstrapEnabled` 为 `false`。用户可写来源（本地文件、Windows `HKCU` 策略）的不可读值不算已设置。空值（仅空格属于不可读，不是空值）和 Windows `REG_BINARY`、`REG_MULTI_SZ`、`REG_QWORD` 类型值也按未设置读取。未设时标准模式启动，除非其他设置请求第三方模式，例如未被 `bootstrapEnabled` 关闭的 `bootstrapUrl`。非所选提供商的键忽略。各提供商必需键见“推理提供商”下专页。

edits.original: The app deletes whole sessions in the background shortly after it fetches this configuration (at launch and on each re-poll), or some minutes after launch and then daily when the configuration comes from device management alone. Idle time runs from the session's last activity; viewing an old Code session counts as activity, viewing an old chat or Cowork task without continuing it does not durably. A session that is running or open on screen is skipped and checked again on the next pass, as is a chat or Cowork task whose folder changed on disk within the period. Pinned sessions are not exempt. Minimum 1 day; a value that cannot be read as a whole number of days deletes nothing. Set through the served configuration or in the device-management profile that carries the rest of the configuration. What it does not reach: another account's sessions on the device (evaluated when that account signs in), Code sessions on a remote machine (SSH/WSL), Cowork background (dispatch) tasks the sidebar does not list, a chat or Cowork task whose folder cannot be located, and Claude Code files not named by a session id (prompt history, plans, shell snapshots), which keep Claude Code's own retention. Honored only by Claude Desktop configured for a third-party model provider.
edits.translation: 应用获取此配置后不久（启动及每次轮询）在后台删除整个会话；若仅来自设备管理，则启动几分钟后开始，之后每天检查。无活动时间从最后活动计算：查看旧 Code 会话算活动，仅查看而不继续旧聊天或 Cowork 不会持久更新活动。正在运行或屏幕打开的会话会跳过，下次再查；期限内磁盘文件夹有变动的聊天或 Cowork 也跳过。置顶会话不豁免。最短 1 天；不能读取为整天数的值不删除任何内容。由服务器配置或包含其余配置的设备管理配置下发。以下不覆盖：本机其他账户会话（该账户登录时检查）、远程 SSH/WSL Code、侧边栏未列出的 Cowork 后台 dispatch 任务、无法定位文件夹的聊天/Cowork，以及不按会话 ID 命名的 Claude Code 文件（提示历史、计划、shell 快照），后者仍遵循 Claude Code 自身保留规则。仅第三方模型提供商配置的 Claude Desktop 实施。

A plain hostname entry (`example.com`) also covers its `www.` form, and a `www.` entry covers the bare name, but no other subdomain. `localhost` dev servers are always reachable, so listing them changes nothing.

Applies when `builtinBrowserEnabled` is on, in both Cowork and Code sessions, and decides which sites Claude may open, read, or act on with its browser tools; users can still view any site themselves. `allow` (default): every site except entries in `builtinBrowserBlockedDomains`. `block`: no site except entries in `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains`. Under either policy `coworkEgressAllowedHosts`, when set to anything but `*`, is an outer bound: sites outside it are refused to Claude in the browser too. A site Anthropic's site safety list blocks stays blocked to Claude under either policy (see `builtinBrowserEnabled`); for a site the list only flags for confirmation, Claude asks the user before each of its actions under `allow`, and skips that confirmation only when the site matches a `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains` entry under `block`. A value that cannot be read is treated as `block` until it is fixed.

The policy also limits what pages load: a page in the pane, including one a user opened, cannot load frames, scripts, images, or other content from a site the policy does not admit (a blocked page a user opens still loads content from its own site). Under `block`, or with a `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` list, include the CDN and API hosts your allowed sites depend on.

This key and the two site lists work the same way as the Claude in Chrome site policy in the admin console. They are set separately here, except on an install managed from the Claude admin console, where they follow your organization's browser site permissions there.
edits.translation:
`builtinBrowserEnabled` 开启时适用 Cowork 和 Code，决定 Claude 可通过浏览器工具打开、读取或操作哪些站点；用户仍可自行查看任意站点。`allow`（默认）允许除 `builtinBrowserBlockedDomains` 外的所有站点；`block` 仅允许 `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains`。两种策略下，`coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 若非 `*` 都构成外围限制，名单外站点也不允许 Claude 浏览。Anthropic 安全名单阻止的站点仍阻止（见 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）；仅标记为需确认的站点，在 `allow` 下逐操作询问，仅在 `block` 下匹配 `builtinBrowserAllowedDomains` 时免确认。不可读值按 `block` 处理，直至修复。

策略也限制页面加载：包括用户打开的页面，都不能从策略未允许的站点加载框架、脚本、图片或其他资源；用户打开的被阻止页面仍可加载其自身站点内容。在 `block` 或使用 `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 列表时，也须列出允许站点依赖的 CDN 和 API 主机。

此键与两个名单和管理控制台 Claude in Chrome 站点策略方式相同，但在此分别设置；控制台管理的安装直接遵循组织浏览器站点权限。

edits.original: Runs only when set to `true`. When the app launches under this organization, it copies this computer's earlier third-party sessions (written under an earlier configuration, or by an earlier build) into its session store in the background, through the same importer Settings → Import uses (new session ids, except conversations previously imported from Claude.ai, which keep theirs; originals left in place). Runs at most once per device under device-delivered configuration (device management, a configuration file or a bootstrap URL) and once more after the device joins the organization's hosted configuration. Under the organization's hosted configuration it takes sessions from any earlier device configuration (including ones a console sign-in created) but never sessions stored under another organization's hosted configuration; under device-delivered configuration it takes only sessions stored while no organization ID was configured, and only once an organization ID is configured. Turn on `enabled` as well so users can import anything it leaves out by hand.

edits.original: When the organization's configuration uses a field that is deprecated — a renamed key, or a legacy value or entry form — the app shows every user a dismissable warning naming the field, what to use instead, and the date support ends (each field's cut-off is listed in the configuration changelog and takes effect at 12:00 PM Pacific Time on that date). The warning shows from the field's announced warning date until dismissed, and once more in the 24 hours before the cut-off. Set this to `true` to suppress the first showing for your users while you migrate; the final 24-hour reminder is always shown, and the deprecation stays listed in the diagnostic report (Help → Troubleshooting) and the hosted configuration editor regardless.

edits.original: Set through your device management (MDM or machine policy) to the UUID of the organization your users sign in to; a value in a user's own configuration file is ignored. After a user signs in to that organization in Claude Desktop on a computer where an earlier third-party configuration of Claude Desktop left chats, Cowork tasks or Code sessions, the app copies them into the user's first-party profile on the same computer. Nothing is uploaded by the copy; once the user resumes a copied session it behaves like any other first-party session. The copy runs in the background, once per account and organization, and leaves the originals in place. Without this key, the organization's own setting (Admin settings in claude.ai) decides, and a deployed key takes precedence over it. A value that is not a UUID is reported as a configuration error and copies nothing; one that names a different organization than the one signed in copies nothing and is noted in the app's log. Like other first-party keys, deploying it puts the app's configuration under management, so a third-party connection a user set up in the app's own settings no longer applies. Anthropic can switch the copy off remotely.
edits.translation: 由 MDM 或机器策略设为登录组织 UUID，用户自身配置文件忽略。登录该组织后，若本机此前第三方配置留下聊天/Cowork/Code，后台复制到本机第一方用户配置，每账户和组织一次，原件保留。复制不上传；继续会话后与其他第一方会话一样。未设时由 claude.ai 组织管理设置决定，本键优先。非 UUID 报配置错误且不复制，组织不同不复制并写日志。与其他第一方键一样，部署使配置受管理，用户在应用内设的第三方连接不再适用。Anthropic 可远程关闭复制。

edits.original:
Free-text instructions from your organization that Claude Desktop appends, in a clearly delimited block, after its own system prompt in **Chat**, **Cowork**, and **Code** (every chat, task, and Code session, including the sub-agents they spawn): for example house style, data-handling rules, or topics to decline. The model is told these instructions come from the organization's administrator and take priority over a user's personal preferences.

This is guidance the model follows, not an enforced control: like any system-prompt text it steers the model's behavior and is usually honored, but it does not guarantee an outcome and is not a substitute for the restriction keys (tool policy, egress allowlist, folder allowlist). The app's own system prompt is never replaced or shortened by this key; in Code sessions it is added after Claude Code's own prompt and any `CLAUDE.md` instructions still apply.

Read from the app's loaded configuration when a session starts; a changed value generally takes effect for sessions started after the next app launch. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; an empty string is treated as unset. Maximum 3,000 characters; a longer value is rejected (the key is ignored with a configuration error) rather than truncated. Line breaks are preserved when the value is delivered as JSON, a bootstrap response, a `.mobileconfig` profile, or a `.reg` file; the Group Policy (ADMX) and Intune text box for this setting is single-line.
edits.translation:
组织自由文本指令，Claude Desktop 在自身系统提示后以清晰分隔块追加，适用于**聊天**、**Cowork**、**Code** 全部对话、任务、会话及其子代理，如内部风格、数据处理规则或拒绝话题。模型被告知来自组织管理员，优先于个人偏好。

这是模型指导，不是强制控制；通常会遵循，但不保证结果，不能替代工具策略、出站或文件夹名单。不会替换或缩短应用提示；Code 追加在 Claude Code 提示后，`CLAUDE.md` 仍适用。

会话启动时读取已加载配置，一般对下次应用启动后创建的会话生效。去掉首尾空白，空串视为未设置。最多 3,000 字符，超长拒绝并记录配置错误，不截断。JSON、引导响应、`.mobileconfig` 配置、`.reg` 文件保留换行；组策略 ADMX 和 Intune 文本框单行。

edits.original: When on (default), the app resolves the signed-in user's identity from the configured credential source (the identity provider claim, or the OS login name when no claim is available) and shows it in the sidebar footer, the account menu, and the Code session greeting. If an OpenTelemetry collector is configured, the same identity is also emitted as the `enduser.id` resource attribute on every span, metric, and log sent to your collector — unless you have set a static `enduser.id` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes, in which case your static value is kept and the runtime identity is not emitted. When off, no identity is shown in the app and no runtime `enduser.id` is emitted; a static `enduser.id` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes still passes through unchanged. This setting does not gate the `process.owner` resource attribute (the OS login name), which is standard OpenTelemetry process metadata and is always emitted — set a static `process.owner` under OpenTelemetry resource attributes to override it. Applies to both Cowork tasks and Code sessions.

edits.original:
When set to `true`, the Cowork workspace VM on macOS and Windows gets a static IPv6 address (a unique local `fd…` address) and an IPv6 default route on its virtual network next to its IPv4 address, and the VM's gateway forwards that traffic over the device's own IPv6 connectivity, as it already does for IPv4. Use it when the tools the agent runs in the VM (shell commands, package installs, `git`, and plugin commands) must reach IPv6-only destinations. The VM's resolver then also returns IPv6 (AAAA) answers. A connection the VM makes over IPv6 succeeds only where the device's own IPv6 does; on a device without working IPv6, destinations that have both keep working over IPv4 and IPv6-only destinations stay unreachable. Because the VM's address is unique-local, most tools in it keep preferring IPv4 for destinations that have both, so IPv6 mostly carries traffic to IPv6-only destinations.

This is a reachability setting, not an egress control: `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` keeps deciding which hostnames the agent's tools may reach, by name, over either protocol, and IPv6 literals are still not accepted there. Hosts your policies allow must also be reachable, and filtered the way you intend, over IPv6 on your network.

Unset (default): the VM is IPv4-only and its resolver returns no IPv6 answers. A change takes effect the next time the workspace VM starts, typically at the next app launch. Does not apply to the Cowork workspace VM on Linux or to Code sessions, which use the device's own network stack.
edits.translation:
设为 `true` 后，macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机在 IPv4 外获得静态 IPv6 唯一本地 `fd…` 地址及默认路由，网关通过设备自身 IPv6 转发，与 IPv4 相同。shell、包安装、`git`、插件命令需访问仅 IPv6 目标时可使用，解析器也返回 AAAA。只有设备自身 IPv6 可用，虚拟机 IPv6 才成功；没有可用 IPv6 时，双栈仍走 IPv4，仅 IPv6 目标不可达。唯一本地地址使多数工具对双栈仍优先 IPv4，主要承载仅 IPv6 流量。

这是连通性设置，不是出站控制，`coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 仍按名称控制两种协议主机，不接受 IPv6 字面地址。允许的主机也须在 IPv6 网络可达并按预期过滤。

默认虚拟机仅 IPv4，解析器不返回 IPv6。下次虚拟机启动、通常下次应用启动生效。不适用 Linux Cowork 或使用设备网络栈的 Code。

"When set to `true`, the Cowork workspace VM on macOS and Windows gets a static IPv6 address (a unique local `fd…` address) and an IPv6 default route on its virtual network next to its IPv4 address, and the VM's gateway forwards that traffic over the device's own IPv6 connectivity, as it already does for IPv4. Use it when the tools the agent runs in the VM (shell commands, package installs, `git`, and plugin commands) must reach IPv6-only destinations. The VM's resolver then also returns IPv6 (AAAA) answers. A connection the VM makes over IPv6 succeeds only where the device's own IPv6 does; on a device without working IPv6, destinations that have both keep working over IPv4 and IPv6-only destinations stay unreachable. Because the VM's address is unique-local, most tools in it keep preferring IPv4 for destinations that have both, so IPv6 mostly carries traffic to IPv6-only destinations.

This is a reachability setting, not an egress control: `coworkEgressAllowedHosts` keeps deciding which hostnames the agent's tools may reach, by name, over either protocol, and IPv6 literals are still not accepted there. Hosts your policies allow must also be reachable, and filtered the way you intend, over IPv6 on your network.

Unset (default): the VM is IPv4-only and its resolver returns no IPv6 answers. A change takes effect the next time the workspace VM starts, typically at the next app launch. Does not apply to the Cowork workspace VM on Linux or to Code sessions, which use the device's own network stack."
edits.replacement:
"设为 `true` 后，macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机在 IPv4 外获得静态 IPv6 唯一本地 `fd…` 地址及默认路由，网关通过设备自身 IPv6 转发，与 IPv4 相同。shell、包安装、`git`、插件命令需访问仅 IPv6 目标时可使用，解析器也返回 AAAA。只有设备自身 IPv6 可用，虚拟机 IPv6 才成功；没有可用 IPv6 时，双栈仍走 IPv4，仅 IPv6 目标不可达。唯一本地地址使多数工具对双栈仍优先 IPv4，主要承载仅 IPv6 流量。

这是连通性设置，不是出站控制，`coworkEgressAllowedHosts` 仍按名称控制两种协议主机，不接受 IPv6 字面地址。允许的主机也须在 IPv6 网络可达并按预期过滤。

默认虚拟机仅 IPv4，解析器不返回 IPv6。下次虚拟机启动、通常下次应用启动生效。不适用 Linux Cowork 或使用设备网络栈的 Code。"

The ID of the endpoint security (EDR) vendor that signed the package `coworkEDRIntegration` points to: 1 to 32 characters from a to z, 0 to 9 and the hyphen, not starting with a hyphen, for example `example-vendor`. It must be an ID this release of Claude accepts; ask your vendor which ID to use. Required whenever `coworkEDRIntegration` is set. The workspace VM runs the package only if this vendor signed it; a package signed by anyone else is refused, even another vendor this release of Claude accepts. The signature the VM checks is the `.sig` file described under `coworkEDRIntegration`. macOS only.

Claude reads this key only from the configuration described under `coworkEDRIntegration`, and ignores a value from anywhere else. It is one of the app-behavior keys (see `coworkEDRIntegration`), so put it in the same profile as every other app-behavior key you use.

Unset (default): if `coworkEDRIntegration` is set, nothing is installed, and each time the workspace VM starts `cowork_vm_node.log` in the app's logs folder records the reason, `vendor_not_named`. It records `config_invalid` for a value not of the form above and `vendor_unknown` for an ID this release of Claude does not accept; neither installs anything. To turn the feature off without these entries, remove `coworkEDRIntegration`, not this key. Removing either key only stops later runs: a sensor already installed stays on the workspace VM's disk until that VM is deleted or replaced.
edits.translation:
签署 `coworkEDRIntegration` 指向包的 EDR 厂商 ID，1–32 个 a–z、0–9 或连字符，不以连字符开头，如 `example-vendor`。须是本发行版接受的 ID，请向厂商确认。设置 `coworkEDRIntegration` 时必填。仅此厂商签名可运行，其他已支持厂商签名也拒绝。检查的是 `coworkEDRIntegration` 所述 `.sig` 文件。仅 macOS。

仅从 `coworkEDRIntegration` 所述配置读取，其他来源忽略。属于行为组（见 `coworkEDRIntegration`），与所需其他键放在同一配置。

未设置且已设 `coworkEDRIntegration` 时不安装，虚拟机每次启动在应用日志目录 `cowork_vm_node.log` 记录 `vendor_not_named`。格式错误记录 `config_invalid`，不接受的 ID 记录 `vendor_unknown`，均不安装。若要关闭而不产生记录，应移除 `coworkEDRIntegration`，不是本键。移除任一键只停止后续运行，已装传感器保留至虚拟机删除或替换。

edits.original:
The path on the user's computer of the signed package your endpoint security (EDR) vendor supplies for the Cowork workspace VM. Put its signature file beside the file this path points to, named as that file plus `.sig`. Keep both, and every folder above them, where ordinary users cannot write. Each time the workspace VM starts, it checks that signature and, only if it is from the vendor named in `coworkEDRIntegrationVendor`, which you must also set, runs the package's `install.sh` as root to install or update the sensor. The signature covers only the package file, `install.sh` included; what the sensor downloads afterwards, including its own updates, is the vendor's and is not checked by Claude. macOS only.

Claude reads this key only from configuration that only an administrator can install: an MDM profile on macOS, or the root-owned file under `/etc/claude-desktop` on Linux. It ignores the key in the in-app Setup panel, in any file the user can edit, and from a configuration server. It is one of the app-behavior keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `relaunchEnforcementHours`, `egressProxyUrl`, …), which Claude takes as a set: once your profile sets any of them, values for the others from a local file or a configuration server stop applying, so put every one you use in the same profile.

Unset (default): no vendor package is installed in the workspace VM. Removing this key only stops later runs of the package. It does not remove or stop a sensor already installed, which stays on the workspace VM's disk until that VM is deleted or replaced.

Network access: `install.sh` and whatever it installs run as root in the workspace VM and are not part of any session, so the network egress allowlist, the proxy keys (`egressProxyUrl`, `egressProxyPacUrl`) and the device's proxy settings do not apply to them. Claude does not otherwise limit which internet hosts they can reach; their connections are ordinary traffic from the device, subject to your own network-layer controls.
edits.translation:
EDR 厂商提供的 Cowork 工作区虚拟机签名包在用户电脑上的路径。旁边放签名文件，名称为包名加 `.sig`。文件及全部上级目录须禁止普通用户写入。虚拟机每次启动检查签名，仅来自同时必填 `coworkEDRIntegrationVendor` 指定厂商时，以 root 运行包的 `install.sh`，安装或更新传感器。签名只覆盖包文件（含 `install.sh`）；后续下载及自身更新由厂商负责，Claude 不检查。仅 macOS。

仅从管理员可安装配置读取：macOS MDM、Linux `/etc/claude-desktop` 下 root 所有文件。应用面板、用户可编辑文件及服务器值忽略。属于行为组（`disableAutoUpdates`、`relaunchEnforcementHours`、`egressProxyUrl` 等），设备配置设任一键后，其他组键不再读本地/服务器值，请放入同一配置。

未设置（默认）不安装厂商包。移除此键只停止后续运行，不移除或停止已有传感器；它留在虚拟机磁盘，直到虚拟机删除或替换。

网络：`install.sh` 及其安装内容以 root 运行，不属任何会话，出站名单、代理键（`egressProxyUrl`、`egressProxyPacUrl`）及设备代理不适用。Claude 不额外限制其互联网主机，作为设备普通流量受你自己的网络层控制。

edits.original:
At launch the app downloads the PAC script and asks it which proxy to use for each request, as a browser would, instead of following the operating system's proxy settings. Same value rules, coverage, exclusions, and delivery as `egressProxyUrl`, except that bypassing is the script's decision: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]` still never use a proxy, but `*.local` names and everything else follow whatever it returns. If the PAC file cannot be downloaded, the app connects directly rather than failing.

On macOS and Windows the Cowork workspace VM is handed a copy of the script when it starts and evaluates it for each request itself; there `myIpAddress()` returns the VM's internal address rather than the device's, so a script that chooses by client subnet gives the VM its off-network answer (if that download fails, the VM connects directly). The Claude Code engine behind Chat, Cowork, and Code cannot evaluate a PAC file, so the app hands it one proxy (whichever the script returns for your inference endpoint) plus a bypass for loopback and `*.local` names. If the script answers `DIRECT` or only `SOCKS` for that endpoint, the engine uses no proxy at all, so have it return an HTTP `PROXY host:port` entry there; if the engine needs different rules, set `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` in Claude Code managed settings, which win for the engine on the host.
edits.translation:
启动时下载 PAC，像浏览器逐请求确定代理，不使用系统代理设置。值规则、范围、例外及下发同 `egressProxyUrl`，但绕过由脚本决定；`localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]` 始终不走代理，`*.local` 及其他名称按结果处理。PAC 下载失败则直接连接，不报失败。

macOS/Windows Cowork 虚拟机启动时取得脚本副本，自行逐请求计算。其中 `myIpAddress()` 返回虚拟机内部地址而非设备地址，按客户端子网判断的脚本会给虚拟机返回外网答案；下载失败则直接连接。Claude Code 不能执行 PAC，应用给它推理端点对应的一个代理，并绕过回环及 `*.local`。返回 `DIRECT` 或仅 `SOCKS` 时引擎完全不走代理，应让此端点返回 HTTP `PROXY host:port`。需不同规则时，在 Claude Code 托管设置设 `HTTPS_PROXY` 和 `NO_PROXY`，对主机引擎优先。

edits.original:
Pins the app (sign-in, the connection test, model discovery, MCP servers, plugins), the Claude Code engine behind Chat, Cowork, and Code, and on macOS and Windows the Cowork workspace VM (the agent's shell, package-install, `git`, and plugin commands) to one HTTP proxy. Use it when your gateway or the internet is reachable only through a corporate proxy and you cannot rely on the system proxy. It is a reachability setting, not an egress control.

The value is an `http://` or `https://` URL, usually with a port. SOCKS proxies and embedded credentials (`user:pass@`) are rejected. Give a local forwarding proxy on the device as `http://127.0.0.1:port`; an `https://` loopback address cannot be verified from inside the Cowork workspace VM. Requests to `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`, and `*.local` names bypass the proxy so local MCP servers keep working; everything else goes through it, and if the proxy is unreachable requests fail rather than connect directly. The engine receives it as `HTTPS_PROXY` and `HTTP_PROXY` with a matching `NO_PROXY`; if Claude Code managed settings on the device set those variables, they win for the engine on the host. Traffic that never uses this proxy: the Cowork workspace VM on Linux, credential and header helper scripts, the update download, the Windows sign-in broker, and pages opened in the system browser.

Read once at launch from device management (MDM) or the local configuration file only; a configuration server cannot deliver it, because the app may need the proxy to reach that server. A profile that sets only this key (or only the other app-behavior keys, such as `disableAutoUpdates`) does not take over a connection users set up in the app, but those keys are read from one source as a group, so put the proxy in the same profile as your update settings. Changes apply at the next app start. When `egressProxyPacUrl` is also set, the PAC file wins and this key is ignored.

值为 `http://` 或 `https://` URL，通常含端口；拒绝 SOCKS 及嵌入凭据（`user:pass@`）。本机转发代理使用 `http://127.0.0.1:port`，虚拟机内无法验证 `https://` 回环地址。`localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]`、`*.local` 请求绕过代理，确保本地 MCP；其他均走代理，不可达则失败，不直接连接。引擎收到 `HTTPS_PROXY`、`HTTP_PROXY` 及对应 `NO_PROXY`，本机 Claude Code 托管设置若定义它们，对主机引擎优先。Linux 虚拟机、凭据/请求头助手、更新下载、Windows 登录代理及系统浏览器页面不使用此代理。

/code#applied-as-managed-policy), where a separately deployed Claude Code managed-settings file takes precedence by default. It does **not** cover Web Search (which runs at your inference provider), inference, or MCP traffic. A list other than `*` also bounds where Claude may browse in the built-in browser. When unset, only the inference endpoint is reachable from the sandbox, so the agent's package installs and web fetches fail with a 403.

Entries are exact hostnames (`api.github.com`), wildcards (`*.corp.com` matches subdomains at any depth, not `corp.com` itself), or `*` to allow all. IP addresses match only when listed exactly. `localhost` and private-network addresses are always blocked for web fetch; shell commands and package installs run in a network sandbox that reaches only the listed hosts plus your inference provider. With `*`, that sandbox is disabled and web fetch still blocks private addresses.

Any entry except bare `*` may carry a `:port` suffix (`internal.corp.com:8443`, `*.corp.com:8443`) restricting it to that port. IPv6 literals are not supported. An invalid entry is dropped (with a warning in the app log) and the rest keep working; an unreadable value counts as an empty list. Ports are enforced for the Cowork sandbox's web fetch, shell, and package-install egress; plugin CLIs ignore port-scoped entries for now, and the Code translation treats them as the bare host. Deploy port-scoped entries only once your whole fleet is on a build that supports them (`disableAutoUpdates` pins builds): on an older build one such entry invalidates the sandbox's whole shell and package-install allowlist for the session.

Listed hosts also need to be open on your network firewall.

AD Folder Redirection can point %APPDATA% at a network (UNC) share, where Cowork tasks fail to start. The sandbox cannot mount a network path. With this key set to `true`, the app stores its data in a product-specific `<ProductName>-Data` folder under %LOCALAPPDATA% on such devices instead. The key only takes effect when %APPDATA% actually resolves to a UNC path, so it is a no-op on devices with a local profile and does not move a healthy install.

Because the key is grouped with the other app-behavior keys, deploying it claims that whole group: the auto-update keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `autoUpdaterEnforcementHours`, …) are then resolved from the managed tier alone, and any local- or remote-tier values for them stop applying. Deploy it together with any auto-update keys you rely on in the same managed (MDM / HKLM `Policies\Claude`) tier.

The relocation is a fresh start, not a move: nothing is carried over from the share. The new local folder begins empty, so users sign in again and re-enter their settings, preferences, and MCP server configuration after the move. Nothing is deleted from the share either; removing the key returns the app to the share with its previous contents (including the previous sign-in state) intact, so the rollback path keeps working.
edits.translation:
AD 文件夹重定向可能将 %APPDATA% 指向网络 UNC 共享，使 Cowork 无法启动：沙箱不能挂载网络路径。设为 `true` 后，此类设备改将数据存于 %LOCALAPPDATA% 下产品专用 `<ProductName>-Data` 文件夹。仅在 %APPDATA% 实际为 UNC 路径时生效，不影响本地用户配置，也不移动正常安装。

此键与应用行为键成组，部署即接管整组。自动更新键（`disableAutoUpdates`、`autoUpdaterEnforcementHours` 等）只读托管层，本地/远程值不再适用。应与所依赖更新键放在同一托管层（MDM / HKLM `Policies\Claude`）。

这是全新开始，不迁移数据：共享内容不会带过来，本地目录为空，用户须重新登录并输入设置、偏好及 MCP 配置。共享也不删除内容；移除此键后返回共享，原内容及登录状态完整保留，支持恢复。

edits.original:
When `true` and Claude Code's managed settings name a corporate launcher in `processWrapper` or `env.CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER`, the Code tab starts the app's Claude Code through it: on this device (managed-settings file or MDM profile, never server-managed), and, for an SSH session, through the one in the host's managed-settings files (`/etc/claude-code`; `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode` on macOS). Either way it is handed none of the app's inference credential (claude.ai sign-in, provider key, token, auth header or credential file) and reads no stored login or ambient cloud credential of this device (over SSH, the host account's own environment still applies); the launcher must put one in its environment — `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, or, for the Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry routing the app leaves set (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`; override to switch), that provider's keys or credential file — or the start fails; it makes no non-essential Anthropic calls. The third-party connection test and title generation start directly. An unusable launcher, an unreadable host settings file or another Claude Code version refuses or ends the session with an error. Device launcher: macOS and Linux (ignored on Windows); SSH hosts: Linux or macOS, from any device; never WSL or Cowork; both deployment modes.

Unset or `false` (default): the app never reads that setting and starts Claude Code directly, with its own credential. A change applies at the next Claude Code start on third party (a served value once fetched) and at the next app launch on a claude.ai install (profile or local configuration file).

The key is in the app-behavior group (`disableAutoUpdates`, …): a profile that sets any group key is the only source read for all of them — set it in the profile, with every group key you need, when the profile sets any of them or the launcher must hold against the device's own user; else in the admin console or configuration server.
edits.translation:
设为 `true`，且 Claude Code 托管设置在 `processWrapper` 或 `env.CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER` 指定公司启动器时，Code 通过它启动应用内 Claude Code。本机读取托管文件或 MDM，不读取服务器托管值；SSH 读取主机托管文件（`/etc/claude-code`，macOS 为 `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode`）。启动器不取得应用推理凭据（claude.ai 登录、提供商密钥、令牌、认证头或凭据文件），也不读取本机保存登录或环境云凭据（SSH 主机账户自身环境仍适用）。启动器必须在环境中提供 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 配合 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 或 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，或应用保留的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 路由（`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*`，可覆盖切换）所需提供商密钥/凭据文件，否则启动失败。不会执行非必要 Anthropic 调用。第三方连接测试和标题生成仍直接启动。启动器不可用、主机设置不可读或使用另一 Claude Code 版本会拒绝或结束会话并报错。本机支持 macOS/Linux，Windows 忽略；SSH 主机支持 Linux/macOS，可从任意设备连接；不适用于 WSL/Cowork，两种部署模式均支持。

未设置或 `false`（默认）时，应用不读取启动器设置，携带自身凭据直接启动。第三方模式在下次启动 Claude Code 时应用更改（服务器值获取后），claude.ai 安装在下次应用启动时应用设备配置或本地文件值。

属于应用行为组（`disableAutoUpdates` 等）。设备配置设置任一组键后，整组仅从该配置读取。因此已设置组键，或须对本机用户强制启动器时，应在同一配置放入本键及所需全部组键；否则可由管理控制台或配置服务器下发。

edits.original:
Sessions started inside a WSL distro run Claude Code where Windows host endpoint policy (this managed configuration, and Claude Code's own managed-settings.json) does not apply. On a device with any managed configuration present, WSL sessions are blocked unless this key is explicitly set to `false`. Set to `true` to block WSL sessions unconditionally; set to `false` to allow them on managed devices; leave unset to block whenever the device is managed.

This key is honored only when deployed through machine-scoped management — MDM on macOS, the HKLM policy hive on Windows, the root-owned `/etc` file on Linux — never via the in-app Setup panel or user-writable stores; in particular, an explicit `false` written to the user-writable HKCU hive is ignored (and its presence still marks the device as managed). Because the key is grouped with the other app-behavior keys, deploying it claims that whole group: the auto-update keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `autoUpdaterEnforcementHours`, …) are then resolved from the managed tier alone, and any local- or remote-tier values for them stop applying.
edits.translation:
WSL 发行版内运行 Claude Code 不受 Windows 主机端点策略（本配置及 Claude Code 自身 managed-settings.json）约束。设备存在托管配置时，除非此键明确为 `false`，否则阻止 WSL。`true` 始终阻止，`false` 允许受管理设备使用；未设置则受管理时阻止。

仅机器范围管理部署生效：macOS MDM、Windows HKLM 策略分支、Linux root 所有的 `/etc` 文件。应用面板和用户可写存储不生效，HKCU 显式 `false` 也被忽略，但其存在仍标记设备为受管理。此键与应用行为键成组，部署即接管整组；自动更新键（`disableAutoUpdates`、`autoUpdaterEnforcementHours` 等）只读托管层，本地或远程值不再适用。

Because the key is grouped with the other app-behavior keys, deploying it claims that whole group: the auto-update keys (`disableAutoUpdates`, `autoUpdaterEnforcementHours`, \u2026) are then resolved from the managed tier alone, and any local- or remote-tier values for them stop applying."

When set to `true`, Code sessions refuse reads outside their working directories (the session folder plus any `allowedWorkspaceFolders`). The file tools (Read, Grep, Glob) refuse them in every permission mode; where Claude Code's sandbox runs (macOS, or Linux and SSH hosts with bubblewrap, once `allowedWorkspaceFolders` or an egress allowlist is also configured) shell commands cannot see the home directory and other user folders (`/Users`, `/home`, mounted volumes) and a read there is refused with no prompt; elsewhere (Windows, Linux without bubblewrap, or neither folders nor an egress allowlist configured) such shell reads prompt for approval. The app keeps the user's git configuration files (which may themselves embed credentials such as URL tokens; a symlinked one stays hidden), its own Claude Code installation, and the session's plugin and attachment folders readable (not on a Windows SSH host, where plugin files and attachments stay out of the file tools' reach under the block). An allowed folder that is or contains the home directory leaves it readable.

Users can re-open folders (even their whole home) in their own Claude Code settings with `sandbox.filesystem.allowRead` or `permissions.additionalDirectories`; settings files tracked in a git repository cannot. The key travels on Claude Code's managed-settings channel: another Claude Code managed-settings source replaces it unless that source sets `parentSettingsBehavior` to `"merge"`, and one that sets `sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPathsOnly` reduces it to approval prompts. This is `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` in Claude Code's [managed settings](

Paths can reference `~` and these environment variables, expanded per user: `%OneDrive%`, `%OneDriveCommercial%`, `%OneDriveConsumer%`, `%APPDATA%`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%`, `%USERNAME%`, `%XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%`. The set is fixed; an entry that references any other `%VAR%`, or one that is unset on the device, is ignored.

Each folder is interpreted on the machine the session runs on. For a Code session on an SSH host, `~` means the remote user's home, an entry that references a `%VAR%` is ignored there (environment variables belong to the machine that defines them), and the session's working directory must fall inside one of the folders as they exist on that host. One list serves every machine: `["/Users", "~"]` governs `/Users` on a managed Mac and the signed-in user's home on a Linux host. A folder that names nothing real on a given machine simply allows nothing there. An empty list allows no folder at all; unset leaves access unrestricted.
edits.translation:
路径可引用 `~` 及以下按用户展开的环境变量：`%OneDrive%`、`%OneDriveCommercial%`、`%OneDriveConsumer%`、`%APPDATA%`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%`、`%USERNAME%`、`%XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%`。集合固定，引用其他 `%VAR%` 或设备未设置变量的条目会被忽略。

文件夹在会话运行的机器上解释。SSH 主机上的 Code 会话中，`~` 表示远程用户主目录；引用 `%VAR%` 的条目被忽略，因为环境变量属于定义它的机器。工作目录须位于该主机实际存在的某个允许文件夹内。同一列表可用于所有机器：`["/Users", "~"]` 在受管理 Mac 上控制 `/Users`，在 Linux 主机上控制已登录用户主目录。不对应实际文件夹的条目在该机器不允许任何路径。空列表不允许任何文件夹，未设置则不限制。

edits.original:
Before fetching a page, Claude Code's WebFetch tool asks `api.anthropic.com` whether the domain is on Anthropic's content blocklist, and refuses the fetch if that lookup cannot complete. Third-party deployments route inference elsewhere and often block `api.anthropic.com` at the firewall; with the lookup on, every WebFetch in Code sessions then fails with "Unable to verify if domain … is safe to fetch", and where the host is reachable, every fetched hostname is sent to Anthropic. (Cowork sessions fetch through the app's own allowlisted fetch and never run this lookup.)

Off (default): the lookup runs as it does today, so `api.anthropic.com` must be reachable from users' machines for Code-session WebFetch to work (listed under Egress Requirements). Set to `true` when users' machines cannot reach `api.anthropic.com` (corporate firewall, government network) or you do not want fetched hostnames sent there: Code sessions then fetch without the lookup and never contact that host for it. This is the same `skipWebFetchPreflight` setting Claude Code reads from its own [managed-settings](
edits.translation:

edits.original:
When enabled, Cowork, Code, and Chat sessions place only tool names in context up front, and Claude fetches a tool's full schema the first time it needs it. Use this when many MCP tools are configured and their inlined schemas crowd out the context window. If your endpoint does not accept the request shape it then receives, requests fail with HTTP 400.

- **Claude API, Vertex AI, Bedrock, or Bedrock Mantle with no custom base URL**: not needed. The app leaves Claude Code's experimental betas on there, as terminal Claude Code does, so tool search is on by default (on Vertex AI, for Claude 4.5 and newer models). To turn it off in Code, Cowork, and Chat, set `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` to `false` in the `env` block of OS-level Claude Code managed settings (with `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`). Earlier app versions treat these like the last case.
- **Gateway provider, app versions bundling Claude Code 2.1.247 or later**: requests add only the tool-search shape (the `tool-search-tool-2025-10-19` `anthropic-beta` value, deferred tool loading, `tool_reference` content blocks); every other experimental Claude Code beta stays suppressed. OS-level Claude Code managed settings that keep that suppression or turn `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` off still win; set `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` to `force` there instead (with `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`). Sessions the app runs in Claude Code's gateway mode (an opt-in for users on the gateway's own sign-in) get its gateway-safe tool-search shape instead.
- **Foundry, a custom base URL, and earlier app versions**: the app suppresses Claude Code's experimental betas for the session and the key lifts that, so requests carry the tool-search shape together with Claude Code's other experimental betas for that provider. On Vertex with app versions bundling Claude Code older than 2.1.221, leave this unset while any model older than Claude 4.5 is in use; those engines send the header regardless of model and Vertex's pre-4.5 stacks reject it.

开启后，Cowork、Code 和聊天初始上下文仅放工具名称，Claude 首次需要工具时才获取完整 schema。配置了大量 MCP 工具、内联 schema 占用上下文时可使用。若端点不接受该请求格式，会报 HTTP 400。

- **Claude API、Vertex AI、Bedrock 或无自定义基础 URL 的 Bedrock Mantle：**无需设置。应用与终端 Claude Code 相同，保留实验 beta，工具搜索默认开启（Vertex AI 为 Claude 4.5 及更新模型）。若要在 Code、Cowork 和聊天关闭，请在操作系统级 Claude Code 托管设置的 `env` 块将 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` 设为 `false`（配合 `parentSettingsBehavior: "merge"`）。较旧应用按下方最后一种情况处理。

Set to `true` to also offer **Automatically approve** in Cowork (Cowork sessions still start by asking before each action until the user picks it). Set to `false` to remove the option from both tabs. edits.original:
Keys use the same tool names and argument-scoped rule syntax as **Disabled built-in tools** (`disabledBuiltinTools`), and scopes apply in the same sessions. A bare `Bash` key also governs Claude Code's `PowerShell` tool (its shell on Windows PCs without Git for Windows); argument-scoped `Bash(…)` keys do not. Scoped **ask** rules reach sessions only through Claude Code's managed-settings channel, so another Claude Code managed-settings source replaces them unless it sets `parentSettingsBehavior` to `"merge"` (bare names hold either way). They need the same fleet-wide build support, and an older build drops a scoped **ask** entry as a configuration error (which also blocks WSL sessions on Windows until that client updates), so the tool runs unprompted.

An **ask** entry, bare or scoped, also turns off the app's remembered “always allow” choices for that tool, so each prompted call is confirmed individually. **ask** on a file tool (`Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Glob`, `Grep`) prompts in Cowork, Chat and Code sessions. Calls that Cowork and Chat always refuse are still refused without a prompt: paths outside the session's connected folders (in Chat, outside its scratch directory) and protected or sensitive files inside them. A Cowork task running unattended (a scheduled run) refuses a call that needs approval rather than waiting for someone to approve it. Code side chats cannot prompt, so they block matching calls. An unusable entry is dropped and recorded as a configuration error; a value other than `allow` or `ask` is treated as `ask` and reported. To remove a tool or deny a rule outright, use **Disabled built-in tools** instead.
edits.translation:
键使用与**禁用的内置工具**（`disabledBuiltinTools`）相同的工具名称、参数范围规则及适用会话。单独 `Bash` 也控制 Claude Code 的 `PowerShell`（未安装 Git for Windows 的 Windows 电脑上的 shell），带范围的 `Bash(…)` 不控制它。带范围的**询问**规则仅通过 Claude Code 托管设置渠道传入会话；其他托管来源会替换它，除非将 `parentSettingsBehavior` 设为 `"merge"`（单独名称在两种情况下均生效）。它们需要设备群统一版本支持；较旧版本会将范围**询问**条目视为配置错误并丢弃（Windows 还会阻止 WSL 会话，直至客户端更新），工具因此不经提示运行。

单独或带范围的**询问**条目也会关闭应用为该工具记住的“始终允许”，每次提示调用均须分别确认。对文件工具（`Read`、`Write`、`Edit`、`Glob`、`Grep`）设置**询问**，会在 Cowork、聊天和 Code 中提示。Cowork 和聊天始终拒绝的调用仍直接拒绝，不弹提示：会话连接目录外路径（聊天为临时目录外）及目录内受保护或敏感文件。无人值守的 Cowork 计划运行遇到需审批调用会拒绝，而非等待人工。Code 侧边聊天无法提示，会阻止匹配调用。不可用条目会被丢弃并记录配置错误；`allow`、`ask` 之外的值按 `ask` 处理并报告。要彻底移除工具或拒绝规则，请改用**禁用的内置工具**。

edits.original:
When on (default), users can turn on **Keep computer awake** (Settings → This computer → System, also shown as **Keep awake** on the Scheduled page in Cowork and the Routines page in Code) so the computer does not idle-sleep while Claude is open and scheduled tasks keep running on an idle machine. The Code tab can also keep the computer awake while a session is working (**Keep computer awake while Claude works** in Settings → Claude Code, and a session's **Keep computer awake** menu item).

Set to `false` to make sure Claude never prevents the computer from sleeping: those switches are hidden and no part of the app keeps the computer awake. Users' saved choices are kept but ignored, and apply again once the key is removed or set to `true`. Scheduled tasks are unaffected and still run only while the computer is awake and the app is open.

A change takes effect on a running app.
edits.translation:
开启时（默认），用户可启用**保持电脑唤醒**（设置 → 此电脑 → 系统；Cowork 计划页及 Code 例行任务页也显示为**保持唤醒**），避免 Claude 打开时电脑因空闲休眠，使计划任务能在空闲设备运行。Code 也可在会话工作时保持唤醒（设置 → Claude Code 中的 **Claude 工作时保持电脑唤醒**，以及会话菜单的**保持电脑唤醒**）。

设为 `false` 后，隐藏这些开关，应用任何部分都不会阻止电脑休眠。用户已保存的选择保留但忽略，移除此键或设为 `true` 后重新生效。计划任务不受此键改变，仍只能在电脑唤醒且应用打开时运行。

更改对运行中的应用生效。

edits.original:
When on (default), users can schedule Cowork tasks and Code sessions to run later or on a recurring schedule, and Claude can create such schedules when asked.

Set to `false` to turn scheduled tasks off for every user. The Scheduled section in Cowork and the routines list in the Code tab are hidden, together with every other place a schedule can be created. Tasks that already exist on a device no longer run; they are kept, not deleted, and run again once the key is removed or set to `true`. Claude is not offered the tools that create, change or run these tasks, and sessions start without Claude Code's own in-session scheduling tools (the `/loop` command, its cron tools and its wake-up timer).

It does not remove task files already on the user's machine. A change takes effect at the next app launch.
edits.translation:
开启时（默认），用户可计划 Cowork 任务及 Code 会话稍后或定期运行，Claude 也可应请求创建计划。

设为 `false` 后，对所有用户关闭计划任务：Cowork 的“计划”区域、Code 的例行任务列表及所有创建计划入口隐藏。设备已有任务不再运行，但会保留而非删除，移除此键或设为 `true` 后恢复。Claude 不再获得创建、更改或运行这些任务的工具；会话也不加载 Claude Code 内部调度工具（`/loop` 命令、cron 工具及唤醒计时器）。

不会移除用户本机已有任务文件。更改在下次启动应用时生效。

edits.original:
When on (default), users can create new skills and upload skill files in the app. Set to `false` to block user skill creation: the skill-creation and upload surfaces are hidden (the `skill_creation` feature is served as blocked by the organization), and the agent's skill-creation tools (saving skills from a conversation, skill proposals) are not offered in sessions — the same effect as turning off the **User-created skills** organization setting available to claude.ai enterprise admins.

This is a feature-availability control enforced in the app's UI, not a data boundary: skills are files on the user's machine, and files already present there (or placed there outside the app) are not removed or blocked by this key. Read-only folders can be viewed and searched but not modified in Cowork (by Claude or via the UI). Bash runs in Cowork's isolated workspace where the folder is mounted read-only at the OS level; file-tool writes (Edit, Write) are blocked in-process by Claude Desktop.

edits.original:
Sets the per-call timeout the agent applies to every MCP tool call; a call that runs longer fails with a timeout error the model can see. Cowork and chat sessions default to 180 seconds. Code sessions have no desktop-imposed MCP tool timeout today, so setting this key introduces one there as well. The desktop's own request deadlines toward MCP servers — the managed servers above and, where `isLocalDevMcpEnabled` permits them, user-added local servers — follow this value so they never cut a call short first; while the key is unset, calls to user-added local servers are additionally limited to 60 seconds by the desktop. Values outside 60–3600 are rejected at parse time (the error is listed in the diagnostics report) and the defaults apply.

The timeout is global (there is no per-server or per-tool form), so size it for the slowest tool you need to complete: long-running tools on one server extend the window during which a stuck call on any server holds its turn. Cowork's built-in shell tool runs under the same cap: a single command's `timeout_ms` (itself limited to 600 seconds) cannot exceed this value.
edits.translation:
设置代理对每次 MCP 工具调用使用的超时；运行超时会报错，模型能看到该错误。Cowork 和聊天默认 180 秒。Code 目前没有桌面施加的 MCP 超时，设置此键也会为其新增限制。桌面对 MCP 服务器的请求期限（上方托管服务器及 `isLocalDevMcpEnabled` 允许的用户本地服务器）也遵循此值，避免更早截断调用；未设置时，桌面还会将用户本地服务器调用限制为 60 秒。60–3600 之外的值在解析时被拒绝，错误列入诊断报告，并使用默认值。

超时是全局值，不支持逐服务器或逐工具设置，应为最慢的必要工具留足时间；某个服务器的长任务会同时延长其他服务器卡住调用占用当前轮次的时间。Cowork 内置 shell 也受此上限约束，单条命令的 `timeout_ms`（自身最多 600 秒）不能超过此值。

Code sessions have no desktop-imposed MCP tool timeout today, so setting this key introduces one there as well. The desktop's own request deadlines toward MCP servers \u2014 the managed servers above and, where `isLocalDevMcpEnabled` permits them, user-added local servers \u2014 follow this value so they never cut a call short first; while the key is unset, calls to user-added local servers are additionally limited to 60 seconds by the desktop. edits.original:
Unset (default) or an empty list: nothing is blocked.

When set, Cowork, Chat and Code sessions do not connect a plugin's remote server whose URL matches an entry. The key works with or without `allowedPluginMcpServers`; a server that matches both lists stays blocked. In a Code session that reads Claude Code configuration-file servers (`~/.claude.json`, a project's `.mcp.json`, `claude mcp add`), a matching remote server from those files is refused as well. The managed list above, the servers the desktop serves from the administrator's org-plugins directory, user-added local servers and extensions are not affected: remove those at their own keys. Each entry is a URL pattern in Claude Code's form, `{"serverUrl": "https://*.example.com/*"}` (`*` wildcards; a host `*` spans `a.b`). An entry matches an address, not a server: the same server under another host name or an IP address, or behind a plugin's local (stdio) server, which has no URL, is not matched. `https://*.example.com/*` does not match `http://`, `wss://` or the bare `example.com`; a pattern such as `example.com/*`, which names no scheme, matches nothing, and a lone `*` matches every URL. To keep a plugin's servers out whatever address they use, set `allowedPluginMcpServers`, which admits only the servers it lists. The desktop reads no other shape, the `serverName` and `serverCommand` forms included: a value that is not a list, or that holds any entry the desktop cannot read, is reported and blocks every plugin's remote server (and those configuration-file remote servers), because skipping an entry of a block list would let its server connect. The servers named above as not affected still connect.

edits.original:
Unset (default): with managed servers listed, sessions take MCP servers only from plugins and the desktop; with no managed servers listed, nothing is restricted.

When set, Cowork, Chat and Code sessions connect the managed list above and the servers the desktop serves from the administrator's org-plugins directory, plus only servers declared by other plugins (user-installed or marketplace) that match an entry. An entry in the managed list above with `transport: "policy-only"` sets a plugin server's tool permissions but does not admit it; to admit that server, list the server's own URL here. Claude Code configuration-file servers (`~/.claude.json`, a project's `.mcp.json`, `claude mcp add`) are never connected. With the key set, the desktop starts no plugin server on the computer itself, whatever the entries say. The one exception is the MCP servers it serves to sessions from the org-plugins directory. Each entry is a URL pattern in Claude Code's form, `{"serverUrl": "https://*.example.com/*"}` (`*` wildcards; a host `*` spans `a.b`): a plugin's remote server connects when its URL matches an entry. No entry admits a plugin's local (stdio) server, and an empty list admits no plugin server. Other shapes, the `serverName` and `serverCommand` forms included, are dropped and reported; a value that is not a list, or has no readable entry, locks sessions to the managed list and the org-plugins directory's servers, and stops every other desktop-started plugin server. User-added local servers and extensions keep their own keys.

Coexistence with another Claude Code managed-settings source on the device: see [managed settings](

未设置（默认）：列有托管服务器时，会话仅使用插件和桌面提供的 MCP 服务器；未列托管服务器时不限制。

设置后，Cowork、聊天和 Code 连接上方托管列表及桌面从管理员组织插件目录提供的服务器；其他用户安装或市场插件提供的服务器必须匹配一个条目。上方托管列表中的 `transport: "policy-only"` 仅设置插件服务器工具权限，不允许其连接；如需允许，须在此列出服务器自己的 URL。Claude Code 配置文件中的服务器（`~/.claude.json`、项目 `.mcp.json`、`claude mcp add`）始终不连接。此键已设置时，无论条目如何配置，桌面都不在本机启动插件服务器，唯一例外是组织插件目录中由桌面向会话提供的 MCP 服务器。每个条目为 Claude Code 格式的 URL 模式 `{"serverUrl": "https://*.example.com/*"}`（`*` 通配符；主机 `*` 可跨 `a.b`）；插件远程服务器的 URL 匹配后才连接。任何条目都不能允许插件本地 stdio 服务器；空列表不允许任何插件服务器。其他格式，包括 `serverName`、`serverCommand`，会被丢弃并报告；非列表或无可读条目的值将会话限制为托管列表和组织插件目录服务器，并停止其他所有桌面启动的插件服务器。用户添加的本地服务器和扩展由各自键控制。

Server-derived: the Claude.ai control plane sets this key, each time it serves the configuration, from the organization's Password managers setting (Admin settings → Claude in Chrome → Password managers, off until an admin turns it on) and the signed-in member's access. It is not authored in any form, MDM profile, or bootstrap server, and a value stored anywhere else is ignored.

When on, and Claude in Chrome is on, a member on macOS can connect a supported password manager's desktop app in Claude Desktop; sessions that can use Claude in Chrome can then ask that password manager to fill a sign-in form in the user's browser through the Claude in Chrome extension and the password manager's own extension. The user approves each request in the password manager and Claude never receives the credential itself: it passes on the device between the password manager, its browser extension and the page. The app's usage telemetry for the integration (outcomes only; no sites, credentials or item names) follows `disableNonessentialTelemetry`, and Claude in Chrome's own checks apply to the page as for any of its actions. A change takes effect without a relaunch once two configuration syncs in a row have served it. Off unless the organization's setting is on; requires `claudeInChromeEnabled`.

Server-derived: the Claude.ai control plane sets this key, each time it serves the configuration, from the organization's Claude in Chrome setting (Admin settings → Claude in Chrome — the same switch, site allowlist/blocklist, and per-role access that govern the extension itself) and the signed-in member's role. It is not authored in any form, MDM profile, or bootstrap server, and a value stored anywhere else is ignored.

When on, Cowork and Code sessions can use the Claude in Chrome browser tools (navigate, read page, click, type, screenshot) in the user's Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. Tool calls travel over the browser's local native-messaging connection between the app and the extension and are encrypted end to end between the two; page content is never relayed through Anthropic servers, and inference stays on the configured provider; the extension's hosted URL-safety check stays on, so the address of each page the agent acts on is checked against the Anthropic API. macOS and Windows only.

Before any tool call, Claude Desktop and the extension each obtain a short-lived signed identity statement from the Anthropic API and pair only when both belong to the same account in your organization, so those two small requests do go to Anthropic. Installed from the Chrome Web Store, the extension runs in third-party mode on its own for members of a hybrid organization — nothing runs that does not arrive over the verified pairing, and per-site permission prompts are delegated to Claude Desktop — so no separate Chrome policy is needed. Chrome managed policy stays optional for locked-down fleets: `forceLoginOrgUUID` may name the organization(s) allowed to take control of the extension wherever the policy reaches (a Claude Desktop from any other organization is refused), and `blockedUrlPatterns` may be added and applies on top of the hosted URL-safety check. Requires `isLocalDevMcpEnabled` to remain enabled. Off unless the organization's Claude in Chrome setting is on.
edits.translation:
服务器生成：Claude.ai 控制平面每次提供配置时，根据组织的 Claude in Chrome 设置（管理设置 → Claude in Chrome，包含扩展共用的开关、网站允许/阻止名单及角色访问控制）和已登录成员角色设置此键。不能在表单、MDM 或引导服务器中自行设置，其他位置的值均被忽略。

开启后，Cowork 和 Code 可在用户的 Google Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge 中使用 Claude in Chrome 工具（导航、读取页面、点击、输入、截图）。调用通过应用与扩展之间的本地 native-messaging 连接传送，并端到端加密；页面内容不经 Anthropic 服务器中转，推理仍使用已配置提供商。扩展的托管 URL 安全检查仍开启，每个代理操作页面的地址会向 Anthropic API 查询。仅支持 macOS 和 Windows。

edits.old:
"Server-derived: the Claude.ai control plane sets this key, each time it serves the configuration, from the organization's Claude in Chrome setting (Admin settings → Claude in Chrome — the same switch, site allowlist/blocklist, and per-role access that govern the extension itself) and the signed-in member's role. It is not authored in any form, MDM profile, or bootstrap server, and a value stored anywhere else is ignored.

When on, Cowork and Code sessions can use the Claude in Chrome browser tools (navigate, read page, click, type, screenshot) in the user's Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. Tool calls travel over the browser's local native-messaging connection between the app and the extension and are encrypted end to end between the two; page content is never relayed through Anthropic servers, and inference stays on the configured provider; the extension's hosted URL-safety check stays on, so the address of each page the agent acts on is checked against the Anthropic API. macOS and Windows only.

Before any tool call, Claude Desktop and the extension each obtain a short-lived signed identity statement from the Anthropic API and pair only when both belong to the same account in your organization, so those two small requests do go to Anthropic. Installed from the Chrome Web Store, the extension runs in third-party mode on its own for members of a hybrid organization — nothing runs that does not arrive over the verified pairing, and per-site permission prompts are delegated to Claude Desktop — so no separate Chrome policy is needed. Chrome managed policy stays optional for locked-down fleets: `forceLoginOrgUUID` may name the organization(s) allowed to take control of the extension wherever the policy reaches (a Claude Desktop from any other organization is refused), and `blockedUrlPatterns` may be added and applies on top of the hosted URL-safety check. Requires `isLocalDevMcpEnabled` to remain enabled. Off unless the organization's Claude in Chrome setting is on."

edits.original:
On a scheduled task, the approval prompt for an MCP tool can offer a lasting approval, so later runs use that tool without asking: **Allow for all scheduled runs** in Cowork, **Always allow** in the Code tab. This setting limits how long that approval lasts. With a limit, the button reads **Allow for N days**. Once an approval is older than that, the next run asks again, and approving again renews it. `0` removes the lasting option, and approvals already stored stop being reused. Leave it blank to change nothing. Choose a number comfortably longer than the gap between runs.

The limit covers MCP tools only, and a `toolPolicy` entry on `managedMcpServers` still takes precedence. If a configuration server delivers the setting, then after each launch scheduled tasks ask instead of reusing stored approvals (as at `0`) until the app has fetched the configuration again.

Cowork: if `mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled` is off, this setting brings the lasting option back for scheduled tasks only, with the time limit.

Code tab: `mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled` has no effect. The limit covers only lasting approvals given after this setting took effect. An earlier one was usually saved as an allow rule in Claude Code's own settings: for a scheduled task, the project's `.claude/settings.local.json`, under `permissions.allow`. Any allow rule in Claude Code's settings, including one written by hand or by **Always allow** in an ordinary Code session in the same project, keeps allowing the tool without asking, even at `0`, until that entry is removed.
edits.translation:
计划任务的 MCP 工具审批可提供持续授权，使后续运行无需再次询问：Cowork 为**允许所有计划运行**，Code 为**始终允许**。此项限制有效期，设置后按钮显示**允许 N 天**。授权超过有效期后，下次运行再次询问，重新批准会续期。`0` 移除持续选项，已保存授权也不再复用。留空不改变现有行为，请选择明显长于运行间隔的天数。

限制仅覆盖 MCP 工具，`managedMcpServers` 上的 `toolPolicy` 仍优先。配置服务器下发此项时，每次启动后，在重新获取配置前，计划任务会像 `0` 一样询问，不复用已保存授权。

Cowork：`mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled` 关闭时，此项可仅为计划任务恢复带有效期的持续授权选项。

Code：`mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled` 无效。有效期仅覆盖此设置生效后给出的持续授权。此前授权通常作为允许规则保存在 Claude Code 自身设置：计划任务对应项目 `.claude/settings.local.json` 中的 `permissions.allow`。Claude Code 设置中的任何允许规则，包括手写规则或同项目普通 Code 会话的**始终允许**规则，即使设为 `0` 仍会免询问允许工具，直至移除该条目。
